free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS score of 5 directly exceeds the EAU threshold of 3, which is the primary driver for sampling in this cohort. This decision is strongly supported by the cohort criterion, which has a high track record in cases with no prior biopsy. The evidence converged on biopsy due to the PI-RADS 5 finding and the established guideline threshold.
